home.content: Loom AI is building a simpler way to use AI for writing, learning, and everyday tasks. Our goal is to bring practical AI tools, ready-to-use templates, skills, and plugins into guided experiences that require no technical background. Today, you can explore our vision and workspace, and unlock a curated plan for building a creative tool with Loom Pro. Work plans are for reading and planning; they do not run AI tools or complete tasks for you.

vision.title: Our Vision: Making Everyday AI Easier | Loom AI
vision.label: Our vision
vision.description: We want everyone to benefit from AI. Discover our vision for simple, guided experiences built around what you want to do, with no technical background needed.
vision.content: Everyday AI. For everyone. Loom AI aims to make useful AI accessible to people without a technical background. We are working toward guided experiences for writing, learning, creative projects, and everyday tasks. Practical tools, templates, skills, and plugins will handle the complexity behind the scenes, so people can start with what they want to do instead of learning about models, prompts, and setup. These experiences are our product direction; the current workspace offers curated reading and planning content.

items.question: Who is Loom AI for?
items.answer: Loom AI is for anyone who wants help with writing, learning, and everyday tasks, including people trying AI for the first time. We are building around everyday needs, with no technical background required.

items.question: Do I need to understand how AI works?
items.answer: No. Our goal is to make AI useful without asking you to learn about models or technical terms. You should be able to start with what you want to do and follow clear, simple steps.

items.question: Will I need to write prompts or install plugins?
items.answer: We're designing these tools so you won't need to write prompts or install plugins yourself. Our goal is to guide you through each task in a few clear steps.

items.question: What can I use today?
items.answer: You can explore the Loom AI vision and workspace, sign in, and unlock a curated plan for building a creative tool with Loom Pro. The current plans are for reading and planning; they do not call AI models, create files, or perform external actions. Guided AI tools are part of our product direction.
